gate.durability: Sealing catalog commits remain serialized and FULL; only durable manifests allow native retirement. Per-inode gates prevent overlapping candidates for the same inode.
gate.tests: A paused prepared candidate does not block another worker from publishing; overlapping preparations of identical chunks both publish and reconstruct correctly; existing cancellation, read leases, retirement, crash, remount and self-hosted Cargo tests pass.
gate.instrumentation: Counters separate active seal jobs from active preparation phases; the profiler groups per-worker threads and measures overlapping background syscalls. Same-binary benchmark supports explicit 1/2/4-worker cases.

limitations: Two reversed-order rounds on a shared node, not a statistical significance claim.
Warm OS caches; debug incremental only.
CPU idle observation does not prove background sealing drained.
Cumulative phase times overlap; they are not added Cargo latency.
Same executable and fixed source/profile/output paths; only sealing worker count differs between SL7 cases.
